mapper.select: SELECT role_id FROM user_role WHERE user_id = #{userId}
SELECT DISTINCT r.code FROM user_role ur INNER JOIN role r ON r.id = ur.role_id WHERE ur.user_id = #{userId} AND (r.status IS NULL OR r.status = 1)

SELECT DISTINCT p.code FROM user_role ur INNER JOIN role r ON r.id = ur.role_id INNER JOIN role_permission rp ON rp.role_id = ur.role_id INNER JOIN permission p ON p.id = rp.permission_id WHERE ur.user_id = #{userId} AND (r.status IS NULL OR r.status = 1) AND (p.status IS NULL OR p.status = 1)
